scans.title: T1-weighted MRI
scans.description: White matter is generally brighter than gray matter; cerebrospinal fluid is dark. Explore structural boundaries and cortical folds.

scans.title: T2-weighted MRI
scans.description: Fluid is bright in this contrast. Compare the ventricles and tissue boundaries against the T1-weighted template.

scans.title: Proton-density MRI
scans.description: A complementary tissue contrast influenced by mobile proton density and acquisition settings. This is a weighted image, not a quantitative water map.

processing: MRI kept at 1 mm, brain-masked and scaled to uint8. Z maps linearly resampled to the shared 2 mm grid, brain-masked, and quantized at 0.01 Z per int16 unit. No inferential threshold is applied to stored maps.
